support_jess: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 503/gateway errors hitting hosted inference since the 10:09 deploy. Example from acct `acme-corp`: req_id=rbx-6789, timestamp=2026-03-18T10:12:03Z. Error: "upstream error: 503 Service Unavailable". Their support ticket: https://support.example/ticket/4432
ashwin: Ack, looking. Are we seeing traffic correlation with new routing rules?
maya: I see a spike in 503s across region-us-east-1 starting 10:10. 503 rate ~2.8% on gateway; p50 latency steady but p95 jumped from 400ms -> 1.5s.
eng-runtime-tim: Can you paste the deploy id? I want to check the seed routing metadata.
support_jess: Deploy id: deploy/2026-03-18/10-09/ensemble-v4. Rolling seed weight change was applied. Customer repro steps included a few single-request failures then retries succeeded — but some customers report persistent failures.
nashwin: Running quick grep on logs: found repeated log lines from api-router: 
```
ERROR api-router: route resolution failed for slice=8, selector=0x4f, err=NoBackendAvailable
```
Seems selector value looks off vs the expected range.
maya: Telemetry: route-tag mismatch alarms firing for slices 6-10. We changed the seeding logic in the new routing-mapper; patch introduced an off-by-one bit in tag derivation.
eng-runtime-tim: Yikes, that explains NoBackendAvailable -> 503. Patch diff shows this line changed: 
```
- tag = (hash(user_id) >> 2) & 0x3f
+ tag = (hash(user_id) >> 1) & 0x3f
```
I'll push a quick revert.
leo: Can we do a hotfix rollback of the routing-mapper and pause the staged cutover? Need SRE to hold traffic. @sre-bot please run rollback plan and pause traffic slice rollout.
sre-bot: Received rollback request. Initiating rollback of deploy/2026-03-18/10-09/ensemble-v4 -> ensemble-v3. Pausing staged cutover. ETA 90s.
product-ops-ana: Noting this for postmortem. Which customers impacted most?
support_jess: Top impacted: acme-corp, finlytics, chatly. All on seeded routing (high-volume). I've attached sample request ids in the ticket.
nashwin: Revert applied by eng-runtime-tim. s3 logs show deploy rollback trigger at 10:14:38Z. Monitoring now.
maya: After rollback p5m 503 rate dropped back to baseline (~0.03%). p95 latency returning to normal.
eng-runtime-tim: Root cause: off-by-one shift in tag derivation in routing-mapper change. Unit tests missed because hash shift change didn't alter test inputs. Will add property tests and a canary assertion to reject tag distribution changes >1% from baseline.
leo: Good. For immediate follow-ups: 1) Confirm rollback complete and close support tickets with mitigation steps, 2) run a scoped re-deploy with fix behind stronger canary (0.1% traffic) and automated traffic sanity gating, 3) draft customer-facing note.
support_jess: I've started templated customer update and flagged affected tickets with mitigation. Will coordinate outbound once we confirm stable for 30m.
product-ops-ana: I'll own the postmortem and schedule a lessons learned with eng-runtime and SRE.
nashwin: Quick action items in case people want to copy: 
* Repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'  (observe 503 for some seeds)
* Logs to check: api-router logs for "NoBackendAvailable", routing-mapper metrics tag_distribution, gateway 503_rate_by_slice
* Temp mitigation: rollback deploy, pause staged cutover, throttle seeded slice to 0.01 until verified
eng-runtime-tim: 👍 will open PR with tests and stronger canary gating.
leo: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated with any regressions. :thumbsup:
